title: Module Dashboard Data
description: The dashboard module documentation on hand-built JSON shapes and display formatting.
body: The Module dashboard's own data (PRD §12.13, S-12) and the Runs dock tab's (PRD §12.2, S-14) — everything both surfaces draw. Both wire shapes are hand-built JSON on the Rust side, already camelCase, so the Raw* types are stated in full rather than projected.
